study.question: Does population-mean gradient coupling suffice for conditional click utility of aligned task-mask membership when the variance-gradient term is removed, and does that utility survive counts-only and count-preserving valid-history permutation controls?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: native full membership exceeds counts by only 0.0000604314 in g1-r0078-membership_full versus g1-r0078-membership_counts; closing grouped auxiliary readout shrinks this to 0.0000134479 in g1-r0081-membership_full_uniform_aux versus g1-r0081-membership_counts_uniform_aux. The native uniform full endpoint is 0.6688899334. Detached-moment full/counts/permuted are 0.6678477774/0.6678920926/0.6679308765; variance-only full/counts/permuted are 0.6675362490/0.6675516847/0.6675961738. Thus variance-only neither recovers performance nor aligned-membership utility. The explicit-full bridge reaches 0.6688631544, 0.0000267790 below native uniform full, already larger than the small native uniform membership gap. Provisional hypothesis: the omitted population-mean derivative supplies useful coupling, whereas variance coupling alone is insufficient; retaining only mean coupling may recover useful assignment. This is untested sufficiency, not an established mechanism. Host masks are deterministically derived from action codes in the inspected loader, so the question concerns representation/optimization conditional on existing inputs, not additional information. Only the union of cart/fav/buy membership is consumed in this lineage, not separate task identity.

Mean-only is an explicit first-order surrogate with FP32 recomputed statistics, not an asserted native mixed-precision derivative.

No hubs, broadcast architecture or extra capacity are adopted. Original INFNet paper provenance alone is available through paper:infnet; original mechanism fidelity/priority remain unverified.

inherited_components: Verified initial candidate.py SHA256 ef231472aca84aeadd095e12b3b3c4840ea86cd7a5ae6f4dd77c1f97a0be05ce matches strongest visible g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative; preserve its receipt as unchanged utility benchmark (click AUC 0.6689612706), not silently replace the incumbent claim.

From g1-r0086-membership_full_explicit_bridge inherit standalone model, CONFIG, masked summary construction, all trainable modules and state, action-aware DIN scorer, target-match/ordinal/curvature summaries, task adapters and product-context transfer.

Inherit full/counts/permuted replacement semantics: actual per-block union counts/emptiness, all-valid mean replacement for counts-only, and one shared half-valid-rank rotation within each 10-position block for all task bits. This preserves per-task counts and joint patterns, but only disrupts association; it does not prove independence.

Inherit native-forward custom first-order VJP wrapper. For hidden X, r=(biased_var(X)+eps)^(-1/2), z=(X-mean(X))*r and incoming g: full=r*(g-mean(g)-z*mean(g*z)), detached=r*g and variance-only=r*(g-z*mean(g*z)).
study.proposed_difference: Add mean_only=r*(g-mean(g)) to _PrimaryPopulationJacobian.backward and the configuration guard, omitting only the variance derivative. Both forward centering and variance scaling remain native; direct hidden-to-Dice paths and learned alpha gradients remain ordinary. All current arms compute the same four component candidates before selecting the returned input gradient; no new parameters, modules, buffers, RNG, masks or data access. Emit full/counts/permuted mean-only arms plus counts explicit-full. The latter and existing g1-r0086-membership_full_explicit_bridge complete the full/counts by explicit-full/mean-only factorial. Existing detached and variance-only arms provide complementary derivative-component trajectories. This is mechanism attribution within the inherited architecture, with no verified originality claim.
predictions: Primary prospective assignment contrast: delta_mean = click AUC(full mean-only) - click AUC(counts mean-only). Directional sufficiency requires delta_mean>0 and full mean-only exceeding permuted mean-only. Predeclare +0.00005 versus each replacement as a practical follow-up trigger, not a significance threshold; smaller gaps remain unresolved at one fixed seed.

Performance recovery prediction: full mean-only improves on g1-r0086-membership_full_variance_only and g1-r0085-membership_full_detached_moments. Being within 0.0001 of the unchanged strongest g3-r0065-fixed_angle_cycle_source_bit_negative is a separate utility gate; superiority or mechanism support cannot be inferred from recovery alone.

Compute delta_full = AUC(existing explicit-full full) - AUC(new explicit-full counts), and interaction delta_mean-delta_full. If mean coupling suffices for assignment in this surrogate family, delta_mean remains positive without requiring variance coupling. Use the existing detached and variance-only full/counts differences to describe, not assume, component interaction.

For identical weights, membership input and state, mean-only versus explicit-full changes only training derivatives; predictions and native running-buffer updates should agree before the first optimizer step, and eval predictions should agree. All four arms must have equal measured parameter counts. Report all four task AUC/Logloss, auxiliary mean separately, and host-provided history slices with positive/negative/sample counts; no new unavailable slice or bootstrap inputs are assumed.

Report training/allocated GPU seconds, wall time, examples processed, peak memory, inference throughput and p50/p95 batch latency from the authorized host. Added VJP work may increase training cost; an identical inference operator is a prediction, not a measured speed result. At present only one frozen training seed is available.
falsifiers: Mean-only full failing to exceed counts or valid-history permutation undermines tested sufficiency for aligned assignment. Equal or reversed gaps do not refute all membership mechanisms.

Mean-only failing to recover performance relative to both detached and variance-only full weakens the mean-sufficiency hypothesis. Full outperforming both isolated components is consistent with interaction or surrogate-specific optimization; it does not identify mean alone.

If explicit-full counts changes the membership ordering relative to native uniform controls, the numerical surrogate family cannot explain the native membership effect. The already observed 0.0000267790 full-bridge gap prevents asserting exact native attribution even if rankings agree.

Any forward/state mismatch between derivative modes at fixed inputs, changed parameter count or initialization, modified host inputs/loss recipe, use of invalid events, nonfinite gradients or failed gradient ownership checks invalidates the intended contrast. Failed prerequisite execution is not scientific counterevidence.

Gains below the practical trigger, contradictory replacement controls, large cost or absent independent repetition cannot establish robust utility. Identical reruns at the same frozen seed are reproducibility checks, not independent support.
alternative_explanations: Mean and variance derivatives may be jointly necessary; removing either can alter dense-gradient clipping, optimizer trajectories and inherited auxiliary transfer. Single-component failure is not a general refutation.

Explicit FP32 recomputed moments and input casts differ from native BF16 backward saved statistics/reduction order. The bridge discrepancy may explain gaps as large as the observed conditional effect; calibration only bounds this issue.

Review of other trajectories: balanced full is below balanced counts (g1-r0079-membership_full_balanced / g1-r0079-membership_counts_balanced); feedback blocking lowers both (g1-r0080-membership_full_feedback_blocked / g1-r0080-membership_counts_feedback_blocked); row-local uniform full/counts/permutation collapse to exactly 0.6677354125 (g1-r0083-membership_full_row_local_uniform_aux, g1-r0083-membership_counts_row_local_uniform_aux and g1-r0084-membership_permuted_row_local_uniform_null). These are informative negative branches, not missing data. They motivate coupling attribution but do not prove it.

Counts-only preserves union frequency and empty strata but changes group content. Rotation preserves joint masks within blocks but can leave correlated membership/content and is identity on fewer than two valid events or homogeneous patterns. A gain over one replacement alone is ambiguous.

Normalization includes empty summary slots and duplicate support rows by inheritance; this is distinct from reading padded raw events. Population coupling can transmit membership from occupied histories to empty-history predictions through training.

Fixed single-seed validation reuse can select small accidental improvements. User-cluster confidence intervals require authorized per-user prediction data not present here. No uncertainty interval or new seed result is fabricated. Click improvements may trade off auxiliary tasks; original DIN auxiliary scores remain relevant.
Released offline feedback maturity and whole-window vocabularies/static snapshots limit production interpretation; no new information-theoretic value or online causal benefit is claimed.

cost_plan.estimate_ref: Measured receipts g1-r0086-membership_full_explicit_bridge (451.756 wall / 415.157 train seconds), g1-r0086-membership_full_variance_only (446.819 wall), g1-r0086-membership_counts_variance_only (451.666 wall), g1-r0086-membership_permuted_variance_only (458.034 wall), 32192421 parameters and about 3.07 GB peak GPU memory; protocol estimated unit 481.348 s, validation 75.225 s, per-trial cap 1203.369 s. Runtime snapshot remaining 4306.850 s; public deadline-minus-clock was about 4155 s during preparation. Host ledger is authoritative.
cost_plan.attribution_reserve: Count all four proposed full-protocol jobs, controls included: plan 4 x 500 = 2000 s (allow about 2200 s), plus every preparation/check/failed-call cost. Reserve 550 s for one justified attribution or bridge follow-up if execution leaves resources; do not spend it on tuning or infer replication from fixed-seed reruns. No local training, installation or agent delegation.
cost_plan.assessment_reserve: Reserve at least 1000 s for final suite freezing, reproducible artifact review and necessary host-owned assessment/repetition if authorized, with at least protocol validation cost per assessed model. Test is closed in this phase. Candidate, closest controls, source/config/checkpoint hashes and commands must be frozen before any withheld request. This proposal does not request held-out execution. Three paired seeds cannot be promised under the current fixed-seed interface and budget; document omissions and keep claims preliminary.
cost_plan.stop_rule: Before each host job require estimated complete-unit cost plus the reserved attribution/assessment resources to fit the live ledger; all failures, diagnostics and retries consume budget. Respect existing per-trial cap and hard deadline; never increase either. Do not automatically rerun unknown execution states. If budget cannot fit the planned suite, retain completed receipts, mark missing contrasts untested and stop without a success claim. Do not access withheld outcomes or change frozen training/split/scoring contracts.
